rationale: A wins because it understands the difference between a pitch and a trap: 'Resale and repair stop being a pilot: REI puts trade-in and gear repair in all 180+ stores' is clean retail-ops news, and the union issue is kept where it belongs, in prep. B has real reporter instincts, but 'REI won't say how big its resale business actually is' turns an undisclosed metric into an accusation. Its next step calling 'labor tension, sustainability disclosure, co-op mechanics' the strongest three is the tell: that is a risk memo wearing a pitch jacket.
gaps_in_A: 'The prevailing belief: resale and repair cannibalize new-product sales' is plausible context, not supplied fact. Prove it or label it as a thesis.

'The retailer paying its owners a record dividend' is punchy but loose. REI members are not public-market shareholders, and the contrast needs the actual dividend figure before it earns a business reporter's time.
'repair counter in every store' makes the store experience more concrete than the facts allow. The update says repairs at stores, not counters, staffing, or format.

'sustainability is the second paragraph of that story, not a separate one' may over-prune. With used-gear sales share undisclosed, there is an accountability question to prepare for even if REI should not pitch it proactively.
gaps_in_B: 'REI won't say how big its resale business actually is' overstates the record. 'Not disclosed' is a gap; 'won't say' is an accusation unless REI refused a request.
'REI's record member dividend arrives the same year unionization pushes hit several of its stores' is defensive prep, not a proactive REI pitch. B treats the bear trap as one of the main doors.

'REI takes gear trade-ins and repairs from a pilot program...' and 'REI's bet: gear resale and repair aren't a sustainability side project...' are the same pilot-to-chain-scale store-ops story in two jackets.
'announced alongside the dividend as of today' invents timing the update does not clearly give. Same-year is grounded; alongside/today is decoration.
